description.narrative:
A 7.2 magnitude earthquake struck Haiti on Saturday 14 August 2021 according to reports from the United States Geological Survey (USGS). The seismic focus was located 10km deep, and the epicentre was located 12km northeast of Saint-Louis du Sud, Haiti. A magnitude 5.2 aftershock occurred shortly thereafter, 17 km north-northwest of Chantal, Haiti, according to the USGS. It had a depth of 10km. The US Tsunami Warning System issued a tsunami warning that was later rescinded. Three Major cities have been initially affected (Jacmel, Jeremie, Les Cayes). The earthquake was felt in the surrounding nations of Bahamas, Cuba, Jamaica, Dominican Republic, and others without reports of damages.
